popCulture.title: Metamorphoses
popCulture.creator: Ovid
popCulture.description: Ovid's Byblis writes, pursues, and weeps herself into a spring — the Carian twin whose letter became a set-piece of forbidden desire.

popCulture.title: Byblis
popCulture.description: Daughter of Miletus who loved her twin Caunus — aetiology of a spring and a caution still filed under her name.

popCulture.title: Parthenius of Nicaea
popCulture.creator: Parthenius
popCulture.description: Love Romances preserves the Hellenistic Byblis variants — the dossier Ovid amplified into metamorphosis.
